workloads.name: ci_build_plus_workspace
workloads.description: Real repository workspace files interleaved with 20 epochs of short-lived CI/agent build churn (target/, node_modules/.cache/, .next/, tmp/, *.o, *.tmp, *.pyc), medium-lived active source edits, and pinned immutable assets (.git/objects/, models/*.safetensors).

workloads.name: opaque_renamed_paths_online_learning
workloads.description: Identical multi-tier lifetime dynamics under opaque, non-standard directory names (ws/slot-01..04/*.dat) with zero recognizable path or extension priors; isolates DOGI's online per-directory EWMA learner vs static path heuristics.

workloads.name: neg_uniform_random_lifetime
workloads.description: Honest Negative Control 1: i.i.d. memoryless geometric deletion probability (p=0.35/epoch) uncorrelated with path, directory, size, or burst. No non-oracle predictor can separate death times.

workloads.name: neg_append_only_no_deletes
workloads.description: Honest Negative Control 2: append-only immutable archive with zero deletes and zero overwrites across all 20 epochs. GC never triggers; multi-stream packing only adds tail-pack PUT overhead.

workloads.name: neg_adversarial_inverted_priors
workloads.description: Honest Negative Control 3: long-lived golden artifacts stored under tmp/golden/*.tmp while 1-epoch churn lives under src/ephemeral/*.go, interleaved with normal tmp/scratch and src/core files. Quantifies static-prior failure and DOGI's early-epoch adaptation lag.
